en.headline: Firefighters rescue two workers stranded on Jardine House facade after gondola fault
en.dek: The suspended platform malfunctioned around 6:15pm on Monday evening, leaving the men dangling from harnesses near the 30th and 40th floors until about 8pm.
body: Police received a report at about 6:15pm on Monday from security at Jardine House in Central that a suspended working platform used for exterior maintenance had malfunctioned, leaving two workers stranded high on the facade.

The men, secured by safety harnesses, were positioned roughly eight floors apart, one near the 30th floor and the other near the 40th. Firefighters accessed the rooftop and abseiled down the building’s distinctive circular-window exterior to reach them.

The lower-positioned worker was brought to street level first and was conscious; the second was guided up to the rooftop. The operation concluded around 8pm, after which the empty cradle was lowered to the ground near a bus stop. One worker was treated for a minor hand injury.
The Labour Department and the property manager Hongkong Land are investigating the incident. No further injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 中環怡和大廈吊船故障 兩工人被困半空消防游繩救出
zh.dek: 周一傍晚約6時15分吊船疑故障下墜，兩名外牆維修工人分別困於約30樓及40樓高度，靠安全帶牽引，至約晚上8時獲救。
body: 周一傍晚約6時15分，中環康樂廣場1號怡和大廈保安向警方報案，指大廈外牆維修用的吊船疑發生故障下墜，兩名工人因而被困高空。
兩人佩戴安全帶，分別困於約30樓及40樓高度，相隔約八層。消防人員登上天台，沿大廈圓窗外牆游繩而下接近被困工人。
較低位置的工人先被救至地面，神智清醒；另一人則被引導返回天台。救援約於晚上8時完成，空吊船其後被降至巴士站附近地面。其中一人手部輕傷送院治理。
勞工處及物業管理公司香港置地正調查事件，暫無其他傷亡報告。
